## What it is

The mounting ring. Inside Ø101.2, outside Ø114.4, band 2.4 mm thick and 6.6 mm wide. Four lobes, 4 mm tall, flaring wider where they meet the band. Each has a 4.2 × 8.2 mm slot square to its bolt. Four Ø3.4 holes on the 76.2 mm square. The middle is open for the cable.

## Design notes

- The lobe body is a rounded finger. A 5 mm fillet carries each side outward into the band, so the joint is wider than the body.
- The slot's 8 mm side is perpendicular to the bolt ray. The hole is further out on that same ray, with 1.6 mm of wall.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't fill the middle of the ring. The cable comes up there.
- Don't move the four M3 holes. Those are the deck.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: thinned to the bolt circle. Tabs flank the towers. The middle is open for the cable.
